scripts.lint: pnpm run generate && pnpm run build:packages && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run generate && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run test
scripts.build: pnpm run generate && pnpm -r run build
scripts.db:check: prisma migrate status && prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code
